prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
System: Cedar Falls Municipal Drinking Water Treatment Plant control, River Intake Pump Station to High Service Pump Header. Elements: River Intake Pump Station (Ironwood): auto start by demand/depth; lost permissive alarms/stops; maintenance release after logged isolations. Raw Water Screen Channel: sends Rake Torque Snapshot to Maintenance Planner. Coagulant Dosing Skid (Marigold): sends Alum Batch Ticket to Laboratory Technician; uses Jar Test Photograph Set; holds last approved dose on bad data. North Filter Gallery (Cobalt): staggers washes. South Filter Gallery: sends Filter Run Exception Note to Chief Operator. Backwash Recovery Tank: receives spent washwater. Chlorine Contact Basin: produces Chlorine Residual Alarm (high priority; test annunciation, guidance, acknowledgement, escalation). Clearwell Level Controller: sends Clearwell Diver Entry Permit to Maintenance Planner (verifies isolation before confined-space work); low-level interlock stops pumps. High Service Pump Header (Juniper): lead/lag; produces Pump Bearing Vibration Clip, used by Maintenance Planner vs inspection intervals/priorities; must show stable pressure through startup, transfer, shutdown. North/South Distribution Pressure Stations: comm loss holds last mode; South uses Pressure Zone Handoff Card for zone status, valve lineup, comms before readiness; North checked for telemetry, permissives, alarms, comms. Laboratory Sample Receiving Bench (Sparrow): sends Jar Test Photograph Set. SCADA Historian Server (Lantern): uses Sample Chain Slip; protected; check time sync, tags, retention, trends. Actors: Chief Operator (produces Backwash Solids Manifest; alarm governance; emergency priorities; post-event reviews; coordinates training); Duty Engineer (authorizes bounded emergency workarounds; reviews Chlorine Cylinder Seal Log before storage changes); Maintenance Planner (Quarry; reviews defects, nuisance alarms, drift, access before PM intervals); Laboratory Technician (sends Sample Chain Slip; trained; no control); Distribution Dispatcher (Falcon; sends Pressure Zone Handoff Card; confirms readiness acknowledgement before zone changes); Chemical Supplier Driver (sends Chlorine Cylinder Seal Log); Residuals Hauler (uses Backwash Solids Manifest for load, destination, acceptance). Modes: Normal; Storm Intake Mode (drill required); Emergency (power loss, notify Chief Operator/Duty Engineer); Commissioning (functional, integrated tests; basin/clearwell tested before distribution; readiness after pressure, constraints, comms, contacts verified). Requirements: named accounts, least privilege, MFA, segmentation, tested

New part:
S246: The Chemical Supplier Driver shall follow site access, unloading, verification, and communication procedures established during commissioning and confirmed during training.
S247: Records generated during commissioning and early operation shall be complete enough to support troubleshooting, regulatory review, warranty claims, and future operator training.
S248: Records retention shall follow municipal policy and applicable drinking water requirements, with electronic records protected against unauthorized change and accidental loss.
S249: Periodic performance reviews shall compare actual plant operation with the control concept, including alarm burden, manual interventions, water quality stability, chemical use, and energy use.
S250: Continuous improvement actions shall be prioritized by risk, reviewed by the Chief Operator and Duty Engineer, tested before release, and incorporated into updated procedures and training materials.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
